title: DEA support witness
description: Produced at the moment of an attribution (DEA-8). Names, for every competitor hypothesis the implementation admits, the active evidence item that separated it from the asserted one. A witness that does not name a separating item for some competitor is a witness that the attribution was not entitled to be made -- which is the point: the schema makes the omission structural rather than a matter of prose.

t.description: the time of the attribution, in the implementation's own clock

hypothesis_set_size.description: how many hypotheses the implementation admits. Recorded because conformance is relative to this number (DEA_PROFILE section 6) and certificates from different sets are not comparable.

separations.description: one entry per competitor. Must cover every admitted hypothesis except the asserted one.

separated_by.description: active evidence items whose observed outcome differs between the asserted hypothesis and this competitor, under the implementation's declared model. An empty array is not permitted: the absence of a separator is DEA-6 failing, and it must be reported as unassessable rather than as an attribution with an empty witness.

active_because.description: the freshness and applicability facts that made this item active (DEA-3, DEA-4)
